market_outlook.short_term: Cautious to negative. Oil near $100 and US-Iran/Houthi conflict create inflation headwinds. Dow's 600-point drop signals risk-off. Key CPI data this week will determine Fed path. CVC Marathon suggests equities can absorb 25bps hike, but consumer stress and trade war add fragility. Expect volatility 10-15% range-bound until geopolitical de-escalation.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive with caveats. AI capex cycle, nuclear energy, defense spending, and Indian growth provide structural tailwinds. However, oil-driven inflation could delay rate cuts, pressuring valuations. Retirement gap and consumer stress suggest a slower consumer recovery. 6-12 month: selective outperformance in tech, defense, energy, and EM (India/LatAm).
